findings.description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is not set at that point in __init__ and defaults to None. Adapter.build_response sets resp.raw after construction. Also, Response() created directly has raw=None.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any `Response()` construction, including the one in HTTPAdapter.build_response, or in tests/mocks. In requests, `self.raw = None` is set later in __init__, so it either raises AttributeError (if raw not yet defined) or, if defined as None, raises AttributeError 'NoneType has no attribute reason'. Impact: every request crashes, and the later assignment of reason in the adapter becomes redundant.
